row.compilation_source: forecast.yaml IS2 (GATE-COMPILED, B2C_GATE_REVIEW §2.1; spec §7.3 works it in full)
row.note: NodeScan(uids=[$personId], labels=[Person]) -> exact(1) HAS_CREATOR dir=in -> Order+Limit(10) -> unbounded(0) REPLY_OF dir=out -> TypeConstraint(post,[Post]) -> exact(1) HAS_CREATOR dir=out -> Project, exactly as the forecast writes it. R6 supplies the unbounded hop (§2.3 `unbounded(0)`, whose 0-hop case keeps a message that is already the root Post); §2.7's cast(uid,int) is row-determining here because it is the tie-break under the Limit(10). NOT a `Message`-supertype row: interactive-short-2.cypher's message node is UNLABELLED and only `(post:Post)` is a label constraint — TGIR_FORECAST_FREEZE.md §7.4 corrects §2.6/§8.17's row list on exactly this point, so the message scan carries no labels. Completeness is `top-k`, not `complete` (§7.3, §5.2.1): the Limit(10) makes the relation top-k and the unbounded Expand above it inherits that (§5.3). Gold rests on the REPLY_OF-chain assumption (one parent per message).
